sections.kicker: Prepared for The Corporate Rebels by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: The best line is the founder's. The profile still says concept store.
sections.keep: The voice. First person, plain and specific, straight from fifteen years in an office.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Italy-based concept store for women who dress on their own terms
pins.what: The bio opens with a store claim the feed never shows.
pins.why: The feed is a person talking to camera. No store, no shelves, no place appears in the grid.
pins.how: Say what it truly is: one woman's edit, chosen for you.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: People expect a shop and find a founder, and the gap costs trust.

pins.quote: I do the looking. You do the deciding.
pins.what: The best positioning is in the second line of the bio.
pins.why: It tells a buyer who does the work and who decides. No other store says it.
pins.how: Make this the first line and cut the store descriptor.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The idea that separates the brand sits under a stock opener.

pins.area: Bold yellow sans titles beside italic serif and script overlays
pins.what: Yellow sans, italic serif and handwriting all share the grid.
pins.why: Three type voices on one grid make the brand look like three accounts.
pins.how: Choose one display face and one text face.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The look changes every row, so no single tile says whose it is.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at The Corporate Rebels. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on The Corporate Rebels's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
